site_name: Level 4 East, Red Car Park Brent Cross Shopping CentreLondonNW4 3RA
description: Non material amendment to planning permission 23/4635/FUL dated 05/04/2024 for 'Change of use of existing car park to provide an indoor electric go-karting centre including associated hospitality (sui generis use), associated external works including the installation of installation of extraction plant, new wall and windows.' Amendments include design evolution since the permission was granted, including to comply with building regulation requirements. The application seeks to vary planning condition 1 including internal alterations to the access door, car park layout, reconfiguration of hospitality and track areas, changes to windows and doors within walls enclosing karting centre. They also seek amendments to roof plant including enlargement of plant enclosure and amendments to the parking including removal of 4no additional spaces from Level 4 and 18no from level 5.
